limitations: Scored only on days before 2026-01-01 (--end 2025-12-31), under docs/decisions/lockbox.md. The records it replaces, archived in docs/runs/archive/cross-conformal-funding/, were scored through 2026-09-03, so no figure here is comparable with theirs, or with any record scored on that longer window.

Conformal PID scores worse than CV+ in the 2020 regime, as #122 measured on this window, paired day by day (CV+ minus PID, with a 90% stationary-bootstrap interval): CRPS -0.107 bp [-0.150, -0.065], Brier at +5 bp -0.00312 [-0.00490, -0.00141], Brier at +10 bp -0.00259 [-0.00413, -0.00100]. Its band widens late after the March 2020 break. Eleonora's ruling on #123 adopts it with this regression stated.

Its constants were declared in src/repo_model/recalibration.py by the session that implemented #122, before any fold was scored, and were neither searched nor re-tuned (#123, #124). Its first scored days, before any label is observable, carry the uncalibrated band.
